acceptanceResults.criterion: IAQ-005, IAQ-007 and IAQ-013 expose only their exact GET owner and browser paths and return the sealed projection variants.
evidence: Hrm007IaEntryQueryController exposes only GET /v1/hris/workbench/team/people-changes, /operations/appointments and /configuration/people-employment.
The frontend sealed GET adapter maps only the three corresponding /api/people browser paths and rejects unknown query identities.
The response projection variants are PEOPLE_CHANGES, APPOINTMENTS and PEOPLE_EMPLOYMENT.

acceptanceResults.criterion: EMPTY and UNAVAILABLE contain zero items; PARTIAL contains typed failures; COMPLETE contains no partial failures.
evidence: Backend projection contracts cover EMPTY, PARTIAL, COMPLETE and UNAVAILABLE invariants.
UNAVAILABLE is rejected unless freshness is UNAVAILABLE; EMPTY and UNAVAILABLE reject items and cursors.
Frontend strict parsing and material-state tests cover the same invariants without a blank state.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Every cursor binds tenant, query, population, scope and authorization revisions, as-of, sort, limit and last item; a mismatch or stale revision fails closed.
evidence: Hrm007CursorCodec binds and verifies every sealed cursor dimension, including authorization decision revision and limit.

Frontend cache identity uses the central product-surface sensitive contract: tenantId, actorId, accessMode, productId, surfaceId, contextScopeKey and authorization decisionRevision plus the complete HRM-007 request identity.
Pagination state resets synchronously before a changed query, scope, revision, options or adapter can send an old cursor.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Each query enforces limit 100, the exact sort allowlist and stable itemPublicId tie-breaking without cross-tenant rows.
evidence: Backend request preparation accepts limits 1 through 100, enforces each query's exact sort allowlist and appends itemPublicId:ASC when absent.
JdbcHrm007ProjectionSource predicates every read by the trusted tenant and sealed population.
Top-level required and optional scalar multiplicity pollution, caller tenant input and unknown filter keys are rejected before service invocation.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Field VIEW, MASK and OMIT decisions match serialized fields and fieldDecisionSummary for every item.
evidence: Each query serializes exactly its three pinned response field groups; EFFECTIVE_ON is request filter/as-of semantics only.
Contract tests compare the serialized field set and fieldDecisionSummary for VIEW, MASK and OMIT decisions.
The frontend parser rejects undeclared fields and revalidates every injected-adapter result at the consumption boundary.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Trusted tenant and policy context are never accepted from query parameters or serialized into the response.
evidence: Tenant identity comes only from PeopleRequestContext and HcmPepContext; caller tenant parameters are rejected.
Backend serialization tests prove tenant, target population, profile, duty and purpose are absent from response items.
The GET adapter emits only allowlisted request keys and falls back to filter={} when no nested filter leaf exists.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Deep links are limited to the three canonical routes and available actions are exactly IAQ-005 PEP-HRM-003/004, IAQ-007 PEP-HRM-006/007/008/009 and none for IAQ-013.
evidence: Response action keys are the six sealed hris.action.* keys; PEP-HRM identifiers are provenance only and are never serialized as action keys.
Actual command permissions, field VIEW decisions, ownership and lifecycle state gate every emitted action.

Deep links force tab and focus while preserving only one validated scope (including scope:hcm/non-default), individually allowlisted navigationScope and legalEntityPublicId values, asOf and the exact current-query sort/filter allowlist; cursor, trusted, unknown and cross-query keys are dropped.

acceptanceResults.criterion: All actions delegate to integrated HRM-008 or HRM-010 owner endpoints; HRM-007 creates no command, approval, event, outbox or receipt implementation.
evidence: IAQ-005 action links target existing employee-change request endpoints; IAQ-007 action links target existing assignment-event endpoints.
The backend delta contains only read-side hrm007 projection, authority, cursor, controller and tests.
HRM-008, HRM-010, their lifecycle tests, events, migrations and generated contracts are unchanged and receive no completion credit.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Wrong tenant, profile, duty, target population, purpose, field decision or decision revision returns one opaque denial and discloses no object existence.
evidence: Hrm007Authority requires exact trusted route, predicate-policy and target-binding sets plus live population evidence.
IAQ-013 implements only tenant-wide CONFIG_SCOPE within the sealed CONFIG_SCOPE/POLICY_NODE/LEGAL_ENTITY allowlist and fails closed for every other supplied population shape.

The module pins each query purpose and accepts no caller purpose override; exact wrong-purpose behavior and the generated profile, projection and schema keys remain a central-v51 admission proof and are not claimed by this module branch.
Terminal, unclassified and local contract failures cancel and remove the exact sensitive query; only HTTP 429, HTTP 503 and network failures retain stale data with actions disabled.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Each page renders distinct loading, empty, partial, unavailable, complete, denied and stale states and passes keyboard, screen-reader, 1440, 1280, 390, 320, 200-percent zoom, light, dark, high-contrast and reduced-motion checks.
evidence: Component tests cover all material states, semantic status/live regions, keyboard-focusable controls and fake responsive variants for all three pages; the final workbench file contains 33 tests.
Source includes compact responsive layout, forced-colors behavior and no motion dependency.
acceptanceResults.pendingReason: The token permits component-level responsive and accessibility verification with fakes only. Central v51 generation, route/shell mount and the real browser matrix remain control-owned and pending.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Feature OFF or tenant unenrolled mounts no owner data runtime, sends zero network calls and exposes no enabled action.
evidence: The default gate is enabled=false with an empty enrolled-tenant set.
A trusted admission still requires explicit gate enabled and tenantEnrolled truth; absent, false and unenrolled cases make zero adapter calls.
A synchronous fence plus exact live cache state, current projection and current action checks disables delegation through refresh, cursor transition and terminal-error pre-render windows.
Backend rollout-gate tests prove the owner controller, authority, repository, projection and cursor runtime are absent while OFF.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Changed-path evidence proves HRM-008, HRM-010, generated authorization, shell and historical migrations are byte-unchanged and receive zero HRM-007 completion credit.
evidence: The backend commit and two-commit frontend lineage change exactly 19 authorized backend and the same 10 authorized frontend paths.
Protected backend HRM-008, HRM-010 and migration tree objects and protected frontend employment, employee-change, shell/model, routes and architecture tree objects are identical at base and source.
Central v51, route/shell admission, merge, publish and activation remain pending; business completion credit is zero.

nonblockingResiduals: Deep-link filter and asOf values are allowlisted and structurally bounded but are not yet validated as strictly as the sealed request parser.
Admitted navigation selector-pair canonicalization remains looser than the sealed parser.
